Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

4. e-mail ID (if available).  
- OM, dated 2-6-2015.  
In order to promote ease of living for Pensioners and minimize the cases of non-submission of Life Certificate by the pensioners and ensure uninterrupted disbursement of pension to them, all Pension disbursing banks shall send SMSs / E-mails to the pensioners on 24th October, 1st November, 15th November and 25th November, every year reminding them to submit  
their Annual Life Certificate by the stipulated date, i.e. 30th November.
